messages:
maria (PM): Heads up — infra flagged a 7-day delay on the new GPU pool. We should rework the launch slices so we don't overpromise to the pilot.

alex (Eng Lead): Ugh. Do we know which services are blocked? Is it just capacity or config?

emily (Infra): It's capacity + some NFS mount churn. New nodes available ~Apr 3 (est). We can run a smaller cluster for pilot but throughput will be ~30% lower.

sam (Product): Given pilot customer SLA, I'd rather trim features than delay. Proposal: convert our single launch to phased slices (A,B,C). Keep critical path in A; everything that needs high throughput moves to B.

maria (PM): +1. Drafted a quick slice matrix:
```
Slice A (Launch pilot): auth (basic), inference core, admin read-only, simple routing
Slice B (Shortly after): multi-tenant, billing, monitoring dashboards
Slice C (v1+): optimizer, advanced routing, live migrations
```

alex (Eng Lead): That looks reasonable. Question: does "inference core" include KV cache warmup and prefix caching? Those are infra heavy.

emily (Infra): KV warming yes — if we want low-latency tail we need warmup jobs. We can do best-effort for slice A and mark SLA as "soft" for 2 weeks.

jon (Data): From pilot requirements: SSO + event telemetry are must-haves. We can support basic SSO (OIDC redirect) in A, push full SCIM user sync to B.

sam (Product): OK move SCIM -> B. Add telemetry sampling in A to keep volumes lower.

maria (PM): Decision so far: ship Slice A on_time with reduced perf SLOs, freeze non-critical UI + advanced features. Do we have alignment on dates? If infra ready Apr 3, shipping Apr 10 realistic?

alex (Eng Lead): Apr 10 is tight but doable if we freeze scope now. Need explicit feature gating and a code freeze on Apr 2 for launch-critical paths.

maria (PM): Noted: code freeze Apr 2. Who owns gating? @alex?

alex (Eng Lead): I'll own gating with @emily for infra checks and @jon for telemetry readiness.

release-bot: Deploy pipeline: smoke tests failed on staging at 09:23 — see logs https://ci/reports/99

sam (Product): Can we triage quick? If it's related to rate limiter we can toggle config and proceed.

emily (Infra): Looking. If it's config we can hotfix, but if it's a dependency (new SDK) we should revert.

alex (Eng Lead): Patch in staging now. If green in 30m we proceed with canary. Otherwise revert and rescope.

maria (PM): Action items:
- [ ] Alex: finalize gating checklist by EOD
- [ ] Emily: confirm temporary cluster perf numbers
- [ ] Jon: implement sampled telemetry + SSO minimal
- [ ] Sam: update pilot comms with phased plan

maria (PM): I'll schedule a decision sync tomorrow 10am. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

alex (Eng Lead): Thanks — will post checklist soon.

jon (Data): I'll target telemetry PR by EOD.

emily (Infra): Cluster perf numbers in this thread by 4pm.

sam (Product): Updated pilot doc and pinged customer with possibility of phased rollout.

maria (PM): End.
